page.overview:
What is Mesprit?

Mesprit is a greyish-yellow, fairy-like Pokémon. Mesprit has two long tails encrusted with two red gems. Mesprit has a hot pink face and a flat helmet or a head with four drooping pig tails or appendages, yellow eyes and another red gem onto its forehead.

Mesprit is a roaming Pokémon for the whole game, and the player can encounter it anytime throughout the game after interacting with it at Lake Verity.

The player, with Cogita's guidance and accompanied by Volo and either Adaman or Irida (depending on the player's choice), has to journey to the three lakes of Hisui to get the necessary materials to forge the Red Chain in order to stop "the Pokémon on the other side of the Rift". Mesprit will be protected by a LV 58 Alpha Hisuian Goodra.

Mesprit's test : "Your emotions... Share them with me..." and asks various questions about the feelings of the player at different points of the game. There are no wrong answers. The Lake Guardian will than reward the player with Mersprit's Plume. Once all the "pieces of the spirit" are gathered, Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf will appear at the Shrouded Ruins and forge the Red Chain.
